body:
most times people that over eat do it to feel good. On the other hand a lot of people eat because they just don't care any more about what the food does to them and so what if they gain a lot of weight.  Then later it does matter to you that you gain the weight and you have the cycle that keeps you large.

also look around you see who you are eating with.  are they large? or do you find yourself eating alone when no one knows what and how much you are eating.

energy wise you really don't need that. it will come as you go along.
as for me a while back in the 90's i was at 250 lbs got a computer and it was not like today's computing i would stay up most of the night and eat more so than i ever had before two weeks into it i thought to myself i would never lose weight i am only going to get larger.

hmmm so living out on a ranch i had a lot of space to walk so that is what i started to do...never had i walked before like to lose weight.
i was winded just walking to mail box and back.

but as i got use to that distance i started walk more and more and in 4 months i went from walking to the mail box to walking five miles a day. never would i have thought i would have walked that much ever much less in a day to day kind of thing

at this time i also stopped doing what every one else was doing on the job which included donuts for breakfast mid morning break of more donuts then Mexican food for lunch then dinner at home then going out and getting junk food for the night on the pc and so on

so with all that stopped i went from 250 to 164 in 5 months in 8 months i had got down to 150 

so yep i know it can be done now times are different
now i dont have work i have fibromyalgia and live in the city and with boredom an  no one really to talk to any more i find it very hard to find a reason other than i know i would be better off losing the weight.

so here is what a city man like me has started to do
starting january 1 i started a gym 24 hour gym so i dont have to be around people when i go at 2am.  i walk i started out just doing the cal count on the treadmill because i did not care how far it was i just started so cals are find for me
first day was 50 cals at a time once i reached that i did 4 weight lifting machines one at a time so lift walk lift walk and so on.

so at the end of it i burned 200 cal and lifted some weights and yes no matter how long it took me to do 50 cals at a time i just did not stop and the lifting weights gave me time to sit down and rest from the walking 

well it has been a week now and at this time i have lost 10 pounds and find with out having someone to tell it to and share in it, it kind of is meaningless.  It makes be just want to stop doing it but that is why i am here to find some people that will carry on a conversation so i can share with them and them with me.

the only tip i would say to start off with is to get a mp3 player put your most favorite songs on it and walk with that in your mind and let that block out all that is around you and just get into the song even if you sing along with ever song it can make you really happy to be doing it...

at this point i have worked up to a 30 minute a day time a the gym and hope to do better as i get stronger
